text_block_list.text:
After the break, Winning Ticket burst
into the Trainer's office with incredible momentum...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~! I ate a ton
and slept like a baby over the break, after all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that!! Full power!! Wide open!!
Right now, I am!! In super top gear~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, let's start training~!!
Ten billion squillion reps!! Here we goooo!!"

Having fully enjoyed her day off, Winning Ticket seemed
to be back at full power in both mind and body.
